Analytical Scale: Long-term global trend

以全球森林覆盖率为核心生态指标，从历史观测数据中识别长期变化趋势，并将未来情境作为交互系统的状态边界，而非对未来结果的确定性预测。

全球森林面积的长期下降提示我们需要更具响应性与适应性的交互系统状态。生态变化表现为长期累积，而非单一时刻的突变。因此，交互系统需要表现“持续变化”和“延迟反馈”，而不仅是一次触发对应一次视觉效果。

*国家级数据按照陆地面积进行加权汇总，以构建全球趋势。

*采用 LOESS 平滑辅助识别长期变化趋势，同时保留原始观测数据。

密度 · 碎裂 · 恢复

观察 · 干预 · 反馈

A long-term decline in global forest area calls for more responsive and adaptive interactive system states. Ecological change unfolds cumulatively over time rather than as a single moment of disruption. The interaction therefore needs to represent accumulation and delayed feedback rather than a one-to-one trigger-and-effect response.

Country-level observations were aggregated using land-area weighting to construct a global trend.

LOESS smoothing was used to reveal the long-term pattern while retaining the original observations.
